sentences.sk: V piatok večer ide Zuzana ku kamarátke Márii.
sentences.en: On Friday evening Zuzana goes to visit her friend Mária.

sentences.sk: Mária býva v novom byte na druhej strane mesta.
sentences.en: Mária lives in a new apartment on the other side of town.

sentences.sk: Zuzana ide autobusom a vystúpi pri pošte.
sentences.en: Zuzana takes the bus and gets off by the post office.

sentences.sk: Mária jej otvorí dvere a srdečne ju privíta.
sentences.en: Mária opens the door and warmly welcomes her.

sentences.sk: Byt je svetlý a má veľkú obývaciu izbu.
sentences.en: The apartment is bright and has a large living room.

sentences.sk: Na stene visí obrázok starého mesta.
sentences.en: A picture of the old town hangs on the wall.

sentences.sk: Zuzana sa spýta, kde Mária kúpila ten obrázok.
sentences.en: Zuzana asks where Mária bought the picture.

sentences.sk: Mária povie, že obrázok dostala ako dar od svojej sestry.
sentences.en: Mária says she got the picture as a gift from her sister.

sentences.sk: V kuchyni už vonia zeleninová polievka.
sentences.en: Vegetable soup already smells good in the kitchen.

sentences.sk: Mária pripravila aj ryžu a pečenú zeleninu.
sentences.en: Mária also prepared rice and roasted vegetables.

sentences.sk: Zuzana prinesie malý koláč s jablkami.
sentences.en: Zuzana brings a small apple cake.

sentences.sk: Obe kamarátky si sadnú k stolu.
sentences.en: Both friends sit down at the table.

sentences.sk: Najprv jedia polievku a rozprávajú sa o práci.
sentences.en: First they eat soup and talk about work.

sentences.sk: Potom si dajú ryžu so zeleninou.
sentences.en: Then they have rice with vegetables.

sentences.sk: Jedlo je chutné a Zuzana Márii poďakuje.
sentences.en: The food is tasty, and Zuzana thanks Mária.

sentences.sk: Po večeri si dajú čaj a kúsok koláča.
sentences.en: After dinner they have tea and a piece of cake.

sentences.sk: Mária ukáže Zuzane fotografie z výletu.
sentences.en: Mária shows Zuzana photos from a trip.

sentences.sk: Zuzana sa teší, že spolu môžu tráviť čas.
sentences.en: Zuzana is glad they can spend time together.

sentences.sk: Pred odchodom jej Mária požičia zaujímavú knihu.
sentences.en: Before Zuzana leaves, Mária lends her an interesting book.

sentences.sk: Zuzana sľúbi, že príde znova budúci týždeň.
sentences.en: Zuzana promises to come again next week.

glossary.note: Used for leaving a bus or train.
Feminine accusative form agreeing with zeleninu.
Third person singular; Mária lends the book.
